company.name: Velaris Web
company.positioning: Velaris Web builds websites, custom software (booking and rebooking systems, CRMs, dashboards) and AI automation that help small service businesses get more leads, keep customers coming back and save time, on public monthly plans with no upfront cost and no contract.

pricing.model: Monthly website plans. No setup fee, month-to-month, cancel anytime with 30 days notice. First preview within 5 business days.
pricing.guidance: Websites are on monthly plans covering design, hosting, business email, listings, updates and SEO: Starter $199/month (up to 5 pages, 1 email, 10 updates a month, map listings, basic e-commerce), Growth $399/month (up to 15 pages, 3 emails, unlimited updates, on-page SEO, 2 blog posts a month, Google Business Profile management, 20+ directory listings, booking/CRM, full e-commerce, LinkedIn positioning) and Scale from $699/month (custom software, SEO strategy, AI chatbot or automation, 5 emails, account manager, same-day support). One-off projects and standalone services are quoted after a free call. Fastest contact: WhatsApp +880 1989-570693.

services.name: LinkedIn Positioning
services.summary: Profile strategy, positioning, headline, banner, About, Featured section, offer messaging, calls-to-action and personal brand alignment.

services.name: Personal Branding
services.summary: Founder positioning, messaging, visual credibility, brand consistency and authority-building assets.

services.name: Website Strategy
services.summary: Customer journeys, information architecture, conversion strategy, page structure, content hierarchy, offers, proof and calls-to-action.

services.name: UI/UX Design
services.summary: Custom responsive websites, landing pages, service websites, conversion-focused UX and design systems.

services.name: Website Development
services.summary: Webflow, Framer or custom development selected after understanding the project's requirements.

services.name: SEO
services.summary: Keyword research, on-page SEO, technical foundations, metadata, internal linking, search-focused content structure and local SEO where appropriate.
